candidate_definition: Every COMPLETED runtime-v34 stage-final checkpoint for the method and seed across all preserved attempts and 50/75/100 mm curriculum stages that exists when the validation candidate registry is created; no completed matching checkpoint may be omitted.
minimum_candidate_coverage: At least one completed stage-final checkpoint from each of 50/75/100 mm for every method and seed.
success_floor: Frozen-FSM equal-height-weighted validation success rate on this exact manifest.
serious_safety_violation_definition: JOINT_LIMIT episode or non-empty terminal joint-limit diagnostic
body_collision_policy: Body/link collision is a failed episode and remains in all result/failure tables; it is not reclassified as a policy-integrity violation for checkpoint eligibility.
eligible_lexicographic_order: maximum equal-height mean episode minimum longitudinal quasi-static support margin
minimum equal-height mean support-transfer pitch-rate RMS
minimum equal-height mean slip distance when the evaluator records that field for every candidate
minimum equal-height mean residual saturation rate
fallback_policy: If no candidate reaches the FSM-derived success floor without a serious safety violation, retain the highest-success safety-clean validation candidate for a disclosed confirmatory locked comparison. If none is safety-clean, retain the least-violating candidate. A fallback never counts as passing validation and cannot support a claim that the gate was met.
selection_unit: one checkpoint per method and training seed; all three seeds remain in the locked-test analysis
locked_test_access: forbidden until method_freeze.json is created and verified
